subject.title: fix: stop node alerts replaying after Gateway restart

question: Does the accepted canonical-device-ID-only pairing migration contract provide sufficient upgrade safety to merge this durable first-connection alert fix?
rationale: The patch deliberately removes a legacy instance-ID pairing metadata write and changes persisted pairing behavior; the author supplied an accepted-contract statement and regression proof, but the protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Confirm and merge
options.body: Accept canonical authenticated device IDs as the only supported persisted node-pairing identity and merge after exact-head review.

options.title: Request a compatibility change
options.body: Keep a narrowly defined migration or upgrade path only if maintainers identify a shipped pairing record that still requires the retired alias.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge
recommendation.body: Accept canonical authenticated device IDs as the only supported persisted node-pairing identity and merge after exact-head review.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature history and the supplied maintainer-decision comment connect steipete directly to both the original alert-routing design and this pairing-contract repair.
